observations: Photo 0: stack of 4 used tyres on dirt ground, tread visibly worn with shiny patches, no sidewall text legible
Photo 1: closer view of same stack, yellow chalk marks on sidewall, tread wear visible but no brand, size, or DOT code readable
Photo 2: four tyres laid flat side by side, alloy wheels/rims visible in background corners, still no readable sidewall markings or tyre size
White and silver alloy rims appear in the background of all three photos but are not the main subject and no model/size stamped is visible
No size (e.g. 225/45R17), load rating, or brand name is legible in any of the three photos
Ground is bare dirt, consistent with an outdoor storage yard, not a shop setting

identity.kind: set of used car tyres (approx. 4-8 pieces) with some alloy wheels/rims in background

claims.claim: Direct Belgium tyres and wheels (implying imported used/Tokunbo tyres from Belgium)
claims.evidence: No import marking, customs sticker, or country-of-origin text visible in any photo; origin claims cannot be confirmed from images alone

risks.risk: Tyre size unknown, which is the single biggest driver of tyre price
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sidewall showing size code (e.g. 205/55R16) and brand name
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic used tyre, lowest tier until size/brand confirmed

risks.risk: Tread depth and wear pattern unclear from distance shots
risks.proof: Close-up of tread with a coin or ruler against the grooves

risks.risk: Sidewall cracks, bulges or repairs not visible from these angles
risks.proof: Full 360-degree sidewall video of each tyre
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/structural risk present, worst case

risks.risk: Age of tyres (DOT date code) unknown, rubber could be hardened/old despite tread
risks.proof: Clear photo of DOT code on sidewall
risks.if_unproven: priced as old stock, not fresh

risks.risk: Wheels/rims shown in background may or may not be included in this sale, and their size/bolt pattern is unreadable
risks.proof: Separate clear photo of each rim with size stamp and confirmation of what is included in this specific listing
risks.if_unproven: rims excluded from pricing until confirmed included

risks.risk: Mismatched set (different brands/models bundled as one lot, as suggested by varying tread patterns in photo 2)
risks.proof: Individual labeled photos of each tyre's sidewall
risks.if_unproven: priced as mismatched/non-matching set, lower than a uniform set

proof_requests: Close-up photo of each tyre's sidewall showing size, brand, and DOT date code
Confirmation of exactly how many tyres and how many wheels are included in this specific sale
Close-up of tread depth with a measuring reference
Full video pan of each tyre's sidewall for cracks/bulges
Clear photo of each rim's size stamp if wheels are part of the sale
response.reason: The tyre size and brand, which primarily set the price, are not legible in any of the three photos, and it is unclear whether the background wheels are even part of this specific listing; a sidewall close-up is needed before even a worst-case price can be assigned.
